notes: וְעַתָּה split *therefore*(waw, rule 14) / *now*(עַתָּה) on sense; the reverse distribution on English order remains the live alternative and is named in the unit note.

*even to the children of Israel* retained on the second לְ as one expanded rendering under rule 16's second limit (the *even* stands before the object of the very preposition written beside it, and no marker or connective morpheme stands here to carry it). The competing `added` reading under rule 30 is recorded in the note; this is the arguable point of the verse.
הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה and כָל־הָעָם הַזֶּה each write one determiner, so the demonstratives take *this* and all four articles are `unrepresented` (rules 41, 47).
